questions_for_hospital: Has the patient agreed to abstain from alcohol while in recuperative care, and is he willing to engage in any treatment (IOP intake, naltrexone)? Our referral form excludes patients who refuse to abstain.
Could you please send the overnight 07/20-07/21 CIWA-Ar scores and confirm he stayed below 8 without lorazepam?
Could you please send a COVID swab taken within 24 hours of the planned arrival? The 07/20 06:00 result will be over 24 hours old.
Could you please send PT/OT notes or nursing documentation that he can walk at least 100 ft and complete bathing and toileting independently?
Can you confirm he can self-administer his medications, and send the completed IHH referral form?
What time was the first amlodipine dose given on 07/20, and will a 30-day supply of discharge medications be sent?
Is there any history of aggressive behavior, conservatorship/FSP, or sex offender registration?

claude_fit.reason: Medically he is close (MH-4 72-hour hold passes for a 07/21 AM arrival, CIWA <8, COG-2 AOx4, INF-1 negative), but he declined residential treatment and did not commit to abstinence, which triggers FORM-X5. If the hospital confirms he will abstain, re-review with a fresh COVID swab (INF-2) and PT/OT or ambulation notes (MOB-2, MOB-3).
